predicates.label: founder or co-founder of
predicates.definition: Person or organization X founded or co-founded organization, institution, business, movement, or polity Y.
includes: founded or established Y in the institutional-creation sense
excludes: merely joined or acquired an existing organization
ambiguous: an incomplete institution or polity argument
a creator or builder phrase without clear institutional founding
predicates.notes: Founding is separate from holding an office or retaining ownership. The direction is founder to founded institution.
